summary.short_summary: A revised deal model was finalized during the meeting, increasing cash at close by $500,000 to $750,000 while converting some bonuses into earn-outs linked to realistic growth targets. Jeff Kaplan explained the earn-out structure based on a $2 million revenue baseline, which includes provisions for partial credits to address year-to-year fluctuations. The model features a preferred share structure to enable earlier bonuses tied to stretch targets, maximizing upfront value with a 3.2x cash multiple at close. The acquisition aims to combine technical and creative strengths to accelerate market growth, particularly in immersive retail and sports, while ensuring effective operational integration through dedicated teams and fostering collaboration. A tight timeline was established for decision-making, with follow-up materials to maintain momentum.
